Webshell Monitoring

将前面写过的代码集成在一起变成 WebShell 监测工具

import requests  
from watchdog.observers import Observer  
from watchdog.events import *  
import time, json, requests  

# 如果目标API的站点接收到了不支持的文件类型就会报错，因此还需要文件后缀的检测  
def upload_file_check(filename):  
    # ext = {php, html, inc, php3, php4, php5, war, jsp, jspx...}  
    # 可以直接判断后缀，也可以直接用报错来跳过  
    try:  
        upload_cmd = 'curl https://scanner.baidu.com/enqueue -F archive=@%s' % filename  
        res = os.popen(upload_cmd)  
        # print(res) 此时会输出上传结果和文件扫描结果的URL，输出结果的type为str类型  
        json = json.loads(res)  # 转换为json格式，输出类型为dict字典格式，直接从键中取值  
        print(json['url'])  
        scan_res_url = requests.get(json['url'])  
        print(scan_res_url)  
        # 网站有反爬，访问过快会导致数据请求失败  
        time.sleep(3)  
        scan_res = requests.get(scan_res_url)  
        print(scan_res)  

        # 'descr': None 不是Webshell  
        # 'descr': 其他值 是 Webshell        var = scan_res.json()[0]['data'][0]['descr']  
        if 'WebShell' in var:  
            print('[!]==Warning== WebShell!!!' + var)  
            os.unlink(filename)  # 如果是 Webshell 就删除它  
        if var is None:  
            print('[+]==Safe== Not WebShell~~' + var)  
    except Exception as e:  
        print("Error File Type!!!")  
        print(e)  
        pass

    def on_moved(self, event):

            pass  
            # print("file moved from {0} to {1}".format(event.src_path, event.dest_path))

        if event.is_directory:  
            print("directory created:{0}".format(event.src_path))  
        else:  
            print("file created:{0}".format(event.src_path))  
            upload_file_check(event.src_path) # 写入触发的文件路径  

    def on_deleted(self, event):  
        if event.is_directory:  
            print("directory deleted:{0}".format(event.src_path))  
        else:  
            print("file deleted:{0}".format(event.src_path))  

    def on_modified(self, event):

执行后当红队人员进行 WebShell 上传时，只要被API定性为Webshell，会被立刻删除。
实际上该检测方法也是可以突破的，选择条件竞争或者做免杀WebShell避免被定性后门删除。

比如其调用 WebShell 检测 API 延迟时 上传执行内存马，此时被删除也无所谓了。

Auto Add&Scan

将需要扫描的 URL 写入文件中，一键创建任务读取并自动启动扫描

import requests
# 发送代码如下
def touch_work(key,url):
    api_add_url = "https://127.0.0.1:3443/api/v1/targets"
    headers = {
        'X-Auth': key,
        'Content-type': 'application/json'
    }

    data = '{"address":"%s","description":"create_by_reaper","criticality":"10"}'% url

    r = requests.post(url=api_add_url, headers=headers, data=data,verify=False).json()

    id =  r['target_id']
    if id is not False:
        print("任务创建成功,id号为: %s"%id)
    return id

# 核心代码
def run_work(key,id):
    data = '{"profile_id":"11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111","schedule":{"disable":false,"start_date":null,"time_sensitive":false},"target_id":"%s"}'% id
    api_run_url="https://127.0.0.1:3443/api/v1/scans"
    headers = {
        'X-Auth': key,
        'Content-type': 'application/json'
    }
    r = requests.post(url=api_run_url, headers=headers, data=data, verify=False).json()
    id = r["target_id"]
    if id is not False:
        print("启动扫描成功")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    key = input("please input your api-key:")
    with open("url.txt","r") as urls:
        for url in urls:
            url = url.replace("\n","")
            print("扫描url:"+url)
            id = touch_work(key,url)
            run_work(key,id)
            print("==================================")

Auto Sqlmap

深入了解SQLMAP API
信息收集到大量URL地址后可以配合SqlmapAPI接口进行批量的注入检测

Sqlmap 的根目录有一个 sqlmapapi.py 的文件，可以用于调用 API 接口

python sqlmapapi.py -s
  • 0.启用sqlmap-API服务 python sqlmapapi.py -s
  • 1.创建新任务记录任务ID @get("/task/new")
  • 2.设置任务ID扫描信息 @post("/option/<taskid>/set)
  • 3.开始扫描对应ID任务 @post("/scan/<taskid>/start")
  • 4.读取扫描状态判断结果 @get("/scan/<taskid>/status")
  • 5.如果结束删除ID并获取结果 @get("/task/<taskid>/delete")
  • 6.扫描结果查看 @get("/scan/<taskid>/data")
